subject: Mid-cycle tranche: staggered equity grants for hiring surge
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greenlight Talent <offers@greenlighttalent.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-cycle tranche: staggered equity grants for hiring surge

Hi Laura / Steph,

Quick summary: we're seeing an unexpected concentration of candidate accepts for mid-May / early-June start dates (seven roles across eng and infra). Headcount is approved, comp bands are set, but our normal cadence for equity grants is colliding with the 409A quote freeze and the next board approval window. Two asks:

1) Can Legal/Comp sign off on using a small, one-time "bridge tranche" that would allow us to issue option awards with an effective date prior to the 409A blackout? We'll still record them as contingent on formal board ratification, but we need to lock quantities for candidates whose offers go out this week.

2) If the bridge tranche isn't possible, can we approve staggered offer language that explicitly defers grant date to the first business day after the next 409A revaluation (expected 6/10) while guaranteeing the proposed strike and number? Candidates want clear timelines — we risk losing folks if we wait for the full board packet cycle.

Attached: proposed phrasing for a deferred-grant clause and a draft offer for Emily Zhao (one of the candidates) so you can see the concrete numbers. I included recommended grant sizes based on comp band: IC3 = 0.20% (typical), IC4 = 0.45% (stretch), Manager = 0.75% (lead).

I appreciate a quick read — Emily's recruiter is pressing for offers by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks,
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle tranche: staggered equity grants for hiring surge

Rishi —

Thanks for the context and for attaching the draft offer. Short answers up front: we can do a narrow exception, but we need to lock the process and document it. Notes below.

Board / 409A timing:
- 409A valuation refresh is scheduled the week of 6/7; final quotes typically post 6/10.
- Next board packet with grant ratifications is the 6/17 meeting (final approvals 6/17).

Options for you (ranked by legal risk / operational lift):
1) Controlled bridge allotment (recommended): Legal signs a limited exception memo allowing issuance of awards with an "effective date" equal to the candidate's start date, but with an explicit clause that vesting is contingent on board ratification at the 6/17 meeting and final strike will be set to the 409A price published on 6/10. We will cap the total bridge units to X (e.g., 20,000 options) and require a second-level approval from CFO. Sign-off needed: VP Finance + GC.

2) Deferred grant language in offers (lower risk): send offer now with explicit deferred-grant clause (grant will occur on the first business day after 409A quote and board ratification). Include a guarantee to honor the quoted number and band in the interim, but do not issue the option certificates until after ratification. This keeps us clean for audits but is a weaker signal to candidates.

3) Fast-track board addendum (higher operational cost): ask execs to move select ratifications to an earlier ad-hoc board teleconference. This is possible for a small set of hires but will need Director-level approvals and will disrupt board scheduling.

Attachments: I've uploaded the Q2 board calendar and a short exception memo template you can use. I redlined your draft offer and adjusted the sample language so it doesn't promise a fixed strike price (we can't do that pre-409A). See attached: board_calendar_q2_2027.pdf and exception_memo_template.docx.

Next steps I recommend:
- Rishi: confirm which candidates are now in firm verbal accept (list + target start date).
- Stephanie: please coordinate with Finance (CFO) for the bridge cap and sign-off path.
- I can draft the exception memo and the final offer wording if we pick path 1.

If you want we can do a quick 20-min sync at 11:30 today.

Laura
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greenlight Talent <offers@greenlighttalent.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle tranche: staggered equity grants for hiring surge

Laura — thanks, that framework is super helpful. Confirming candidate list (verbal accepts / need offers this week):
- Emily Zhao — Senior Software Engineer, target start 6/1, comp band IC4, recommended 0.45% (8,250 options)
- Omar Davila — Senior Infra Engineer, start 6/8, IC4, recommended 0.45% (7,900 options)
- Priya Natarajan — Manager, start 6/15, Manager band, 0.75% (12,500 options)

We expect two more firm accepts mid-week; I will update if numbers change.

Preferred path: Controlled bridge allotment (Laura's 1). If Finance will sign off on a 25k-unit bridge cap and we get GC OK on the memo language, we can proceed with offers that state:
- Award "issued" on start date (or earlier) but vesting and exercise price contingent on board ratification;
- Candidate will receive final package and DocuSign after 409A price posts and board ratification;
- If board does not ratify for any reason, the company reserves the right to amend (very unlikely, but required for audit).

I've attached the updated draft offer for Emily (draft_offer_Emily_Zhao_v2.docx) — redlines address Laura's comment about strike price. Greenlight Talent asked if we can still use "effective date = start date" language; I'm copying them so they have the current version.

I'll schedule a 15-min sync at 11:30 PT with Finance + GC if that's ok.

Rishi
--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle tranche: staggered equity grants for hiring surge

All — I ran the numbers with Finance. CFO is provisionally okay with a 25,000-unit bridge cap if Legal (GC) signs the memo and we add a reconciliation step to the post-board close process (audit trail + candidate notification). I'll coordinate the CFO sign-off and loop in GC.

Please proceed with the redlined offer language for Emily and other firm accepts. Rishi, cc me on the DocuSign send — we'll need to batch the reconciliation entries for accounting.

Thanks,
Steph

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
